Then set W2's font size to 321 with `cb source apply`, then immediately read `timeline.tsx` and tell me W2's font size there and whether the clip on the Mine track is muted there.

input.description: Set W2 font size to 321, apply, read timeline

blocks.text:
I set W2's font size to 321, and the timeline file read right afterwards shows W2 at 321.

The clip on the Mine track (clip.mp4, 0–3s) is not muted there. It has no mute setting at all.

That file holds back other people's edits until my turn ends. If someone muted that clip in the meantime, the file won't show it yet, though the app will once my turn finishes.
